name: The Rag Queen

source.note: A side quest boss of our own (The One-Horned Billy, docs/story/side_quests.md), built from the 2025 Monster Manual's scarecrow (Fearsome Claw, Terrifying Glare, its immunities and fire vulnerability), scaled to a Huge construct of CR 10 with legendary actions.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.summary: Twice a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the Rag Queen fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead, twice a day.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Rag Queen makes two Fearsome Claw attacks.

actions.name: Fearsome Claw
actions.summary: A long raking claw of sewn bones that leaves the target Frightened until the end of her next turn.
actions.text: Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of the Rag Queen's next turn.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: a creature within 30 ft makes a DC 15 Wis save or is Frightened and Paralyzed until the end of her next turn.
actions.text: One creature the Rag Queen can see within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. Failure: the target has the Frightened and Paralyzed conditions until the end of the Rag Queen's next turn.

summary: Baba Lysaga's masterpiece: a scarecrow twice the height of a man, stitched from the wedding dresses of every drowned bride of Berez, with a mouth full of their rings. Her claws frighten, her glare freezes, and fire is the one thing she fears.
